title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1971-12-31
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/48k) > Adobe Audition CC2015 >Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a legendary NYE show featuring Donna Jean’s debut, Keith’s piano debut, and a smoking "Next Time You See Me" performance.
ai_review.review: The upgraded soundboard source is crystal‑clear, with the hum gone and vocals full‑bodied, making this one of the most listenable New Year's Eve recordings. Musically the show is high‑energy – Donna Jean’s first appearance, Keith stepping in on piano alongside Pigpen, and Jerry delivering a standout guitar solo on "Next Time You See Me". Reviewers rave about the generous 17‑song set and the overall vibe of an iconic 1971 performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are five‑star, praising both the upgraded soundboard quality and the historic, high‑energy show; the consistent enthusiasm yields a near‑top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hum removed, vocals clear and full‑bodied, no noticeable dropouts; listeners note it as the best available version of this show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generous 17‑song set with seamless transitions; highlights include Donna Jean's debut and Keith’s first piano appearance, creating a historic flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work on "Next Time You See Me" is praised as especially fierce and convincing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Fans note humorous banter (Bob’s diaper comment) adding to the show’s character.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's piano debut is highlighted, with Bobby introducing him as “our new piano player”, indicating strong keyboard contribution.
